verdict.rationale: Kit's docs confirm audience segmentation via tags and segment ids (kit-docs-2, kit-docs-25) and custom fields for profile attributes (kit-docs-38, kit-docs-39), supporting building segments from profile data. However, there is no evidence of segmentation based on behavioral events (opens, clicks, purchases) or explicit confirmation that segments dynamically update live as data changes. missing for 10: behavioral-event-based segment criteria, explicit documentation of live/dynamic segment recalculation as subscriber data changes.
